# Tai Nguyen Thuong Hieu & Logo (Branding Assets & Logo Guidelines)

> **Phan he**: static  
> **Tai lieu**: branding-assets.md  
> **Thuong hieu**: Square (square.vn) & InfoHR

---

## 1. Dinh Danh Thuong Hieu Square (Square Brand Identity)

- **Logo Chinh**: Bieu tuong hinh vuong cach dieu kem chu Square mau cam dac trung (`#FF5A1F`).
- **Logo Phu / Nhan dien InfoHR**: Bieu tuong ket hop mau cam Square va mau xanh cong nghe (`#0066CC`).
- **Tap du lieu logo doi tac**: File `docs/static/square-logos.json` luu tru danh muc cac logo khach hang va doi tac chien luoc duoc cao tu he thong `docs.square.vn`.

---

## 2. Quy Chuan Su Dung Logo

1. **Khoang trong an toan (Clear Space)**: Luon duy tri khoang cach dem toi thieu bang 50% chieu cao cua bieu tuong logo o ca 4 huong xung quanh.
2. **Kich thuoc toi thieu (Minimum Size)**:
   - Man hinh so: Chieu cao toi thieu khong duoc nho hon 24px tren thanh Navigation Bar.
   - Ban in An A4: Chieu cao toi thieu khong duoc nho hon 15mm tren phieu luong va hop dong lao dong.
3. **Cac dieu cam ky (Do Not)**:
   - Khong tu y thay doi ty le khung hinh (Khong bop meo chieu ngang hoac chieu doc).
   - Khong doi mau logo sang cac mau khong thuoc bang mau thuong hieu Square.
   - Khong dat logo len nen mau qua roi hoac co do tuong phan kem lam chìm logo.
